 Posted on Tripadvisor  
 
  
 
 
 Rick C 
 
 
 
 Verified 
Unforgettable experience with Summit Experts
Absolutely best company in Pakistan! We had a 6 day action packed adventure around North Pakistan with Summit Experts, and we are so happy we chose them. After emailing and what’s app messaging for months, changing our itinerary many times, they were so patient, and accomodating with our custom tour requests, their communication skills are perfect. Our guide Ibadat, and driver Abbas met us at the airport in Skardu on time, and we instantly knew that they were going to be legends, they’re such humble, chilled, happy, and funny guys. Ibadat is a true mountain warrior, these mountains are his passion in life, so he was the perfect hiking partner to show us his beautiful country. Their English is really good too, so that made it easy for us the whole time. We had an absolute blast, and such good memories with these two. We will never forget their cool playlists in the car on our drives everyday. Anyone thinking about using Summit Experts for your North Pakistan adventure, I cannot recommend enough, you’ll be in good hands and take away the best memories. Thanks Summit Crew
  
 
  
 
 
 
 Posted on Tripadvisor  
 
  
 
 
 natmarie 
 
 
 
 Verified 
Exception company and trip
From start to finish Summit Experts allowed us to design our North Pakistan itinerary to allow us to see as much as we could in our 6 days. The itinerary was the perfect balance of some adventure, lots of activities and cultural exploration, allowing us to experience the destination in a way that felt authentic and exciting. Every detail was perfectly organized, from top communication from the company, transportation and stunning accommodations to the activities and local experiences. Our guide Ibadat was fantastic, a mountain warrior. He was so patient especially with my coffee results haha. He kept us safe and made our trip so wonderful explaining local culture to us. His passion is the mountains and hikes so he is your man for any adventures. Our driver, the legend Abbas was an exceptional driver. Totally professional and he drove so careful and safe. He was also just the nicest guy and we all had many laughs together along our journey. I cannot thank him enough. He was the best driver in Pakistan. I would massively recommend using Summit Experts for any type of trip. For summits, hikes or just exploring the areas. They cover it all and the nicest kindest people. Thank you to everyone who made this trip extremely special and memorable for us. We can’t wait to show how beautiful Pakistan is to all our friends and family. Dil Pakistan. Until we meet again.

What an amazing team to travel. These guys are very professional and locals who knows every corner of the North pakistan. We loved our itinerary which was perfectly mixed up with day hikes and cultural sightseeing exposure. Love your Australia :)

Great mixture of sighseeing and nature hikes around north Pakistan 😍

Nanga Parbat
Thank you Shah and the team for making my visit to Pakistan very memorable. We took a very non-traditional way, with very few people on the way, and yet everything went as smoothly as it could. Despite traveling solo as a female, I felt safe with him. Thank you!
  
 
  
 
 
 
 Posted on Tripadvisor  
 
  
 
 
 Olena B 
 
 
 
 Verified 
A Journey to Remember
I just returned from an incredible month-long adventure in northern Pakistan with Summit Experts Adventure Tours. We trekked through some of the most breathtaking regions: Skardu, Hunza, Shimshal Village, and made our way to Shimshal Pass, ending with the exhilarating summit of Manglik Sar (6050m). From the very first moment, I knew I was in the hands of true professionals. The entire trip was perfectly organized, from the logistics to safety measures. But what truly made this experience stand out was the team. Every single person was warm, supportive, and treated me like family. Over the course of the trek, they all became a second family to me, and I genuinely feel like I’ve made lifelong friends. The beauty of the Karakoram combined with the knowledge, passion, and dedication of the Summit Experts team made this adventure unforgettable. I felt supported, safe, and inspired every single day. I don’t add pictures, because you MUST visit and see all the beauty of Pakistan with your own eyes. Nothing can compare to standing there in person, taking in the vastness and the majesty of the Karakoram range. Thanks to the expertise of Summit Experts, I felt safe and supported every step of the way. The team’s passion for the mountains and commitment to making sure each trekker has the best possible experience is what really sets them apart. This wasn’t just a trek—it was an unforgettable journey, and I already can’t wait to return. I’m already thinking about next year and planning to do even more trekking in Pakistan. There’s so much more to explore, and I wouldn’t want to do it with anyone else but Summit Experts. If you’re considering an adventure in Pakistan, I cannot recommend this company enough. Thank you, Summit Experts, for an experience I’ll never forget.
  
 
  
 
 
 
 Posted on Tripadvisor  
 
  
 
 
 Wasin S 
 
 
 
 Verified 
Trip ปากีสถาน Blossom 2025
It was one of the best trips in my life, whether it was the beautiful nature or the team that took good care of me from the first day I arrived until the day I returned, throughout the 11 days. If you are looking for an experienced team to guide you around, who will provide you with newness and a good impression, I would like you to try our services, and I believe you will not be disappointed.
  
 
  
 
 
 
 Posted on Tripadvisor  
 
  
 
 
 Chongdee C 
 
 
 
 Verified 
Beyond the ordinary
It took me some time to find the right words to capture the incredible memories we created during our trip to northern Pakistan this April—blossom season at its absolute best! The breathtaking views, the warmth of the people, and the richness of the culture left a lasting impression on me, all made even more special by the Summit Experts Adventure Tours team. Their approach was not just professional but also incredibly humble and flexible, ensuring we had an unforgettable experience. Our group of five Thai friends explored Skardu, Hunza, Passu, and Gilgit at the peak of blossom season. Guided by the company’s CEO, Shah, whose extensive expertise in hiking and expeditions was evident, we found ourselves on a well-planned yet refreshingly adaptable journey. We appreciated how our tour leader went above and beyond, recommending exclusive experiences—from an insightful cultural visit to a local Pakistani home to a glacier trek using a unique route. Unlike standard itineraries, this allowed us to truly get up close and touch the glacier, all while ensuring our safety with expert guidance. One of the highlights was our trek to Fairy Meadows. With hours of hiking ahead, our guide was highly attentive, carefully assessing the natural conditions and our group’s well-being, which made us feel completely safe every step of the way. I already can't wait to return to Pakistan in summer, autumn, and beyond! 😊 A little tip for fellow travelers: If you plan to visit areas that require trekking and hiking, I highly recommend familiarizing yourself with the terrain beforehand. You can always check with the Summit Experts Adventure Tours team about the travel conditions—just to be prepared, not to opt out! The beauty of northern Pakistan is absolutely worth the effort.
  
 
  
 
 
 
 Posted on Tripadvisor  
 
  
 
 
 Fuzzy 
 
 
 
 Verified 
Amazing First Trip to Pakistan with Summit Experts Tours 🫶🏽
I had an amazing time travelling to Pakistan with the Summit Experts Tour! Everything was super well organized, and the guides were awesome — really friendly and knew so much about the places we visited. The whole trip was a great mix of adventure, sightseeing, and just soaking in the local culture. I felt safe and taken care of the whole way. Definitely recommend them if you're thinking about exploring Pakistan.
  
 
  
 
 
 
 Posted on Tripadvisor

The great team, the great place and the great Hunza people.
Thanks to Shah Doulat the CEO of the Summit Experts Adventure Tours and his team arranged a great wonderful trip for us. Looking forward to going back again.....

After emailing and what’s app messaging for months, changing our itinerary many times, they were so patient, and accomodating with our custom tour requests, their communication skills are perfect. Our guide Ibadat, and driver Abbas met us at the airport in Skardu on time, and we instantly knew that they were going to be legends, they’re such humble, chilled, happy, and funny guys. Ibadat is a true mountain warrior, these mountains are his passion in life, so he was the perfect hiking partner to show us his beautiful country. Their English is really good too, so that made it easy for us the whole time. We had an absolute blast, and such good memories with these two. We will never forget their cool playlists in the car on our drives everyday. Anyone thinking about using Summit Experts for your North Pakistan adventure, I cannot recommend enough, you’ll be in good hands and take away the best memories. Thanks Summit Crew

A Journey to Remember
I just returned from an incredible month-long adventure in northern Pakistan with Summit Experts Adventure Tours. We trekked through some of the most breathtaking regions: Skardu, Hunza, Shimshal Village, and made our way to Shimshal Pass, ending with the exhilarating summit of Manglik Sar (6050m). From the very first moment, I knew I was in the hands of true professionals. The entire trip was perfectly organized, from the logistics to safety measures. But what truly made this experience stand out was the team. Every single person was warm, supportive, and treated me like family. Over the course of the trek, they all became a second family to me, and I genuinely feel like I’ve made lifelong friends. The beauty of the Karakoram combined with the knowledge, passion, and dedication of the Summit Experts team made this adventure unforgettable. I felt supported, safe, and inspired every single day. I don’t add pictures, because you MUST visit and see all the beauty of Pakistan with your own eyes. Nothing can compare to standing there in person, taking in the vastness and the majesty of the Karakoram range. Thanks to the expertise of Summit Experts, I felt safe and supported every step of the way. The team’s passion for the mountains and commitment to making sure each trekker has the best possible experience is what really sets them apart. This wasn’t just a trek—it was an unforgettable journey, and I already can’t wait to return. I’m already thinking about next year and planning to do even more trekking in Pakistan. There’s so much more to explore, and I wouldn’t want to do it with anyone else but Summit Experts. If you’re considering an adventure in Pakistan, I cannot recommend this company enough. Thank you, Summit Experts, for an experience I’ll never forget.

 Posted on Tripadvisor  
 
  
 
 
 Chongdee C 
 
 
 
 Verified 
Beyond the ordinary
It took me some time to find the right words to capture the incredible memories we created during our trip to northern Pakistan this April—blossom season at its absolute best! The breathtaking views, the warmth of the people, and the richness of the culture left a lasting impression on me, all made even more special by the Summit Experts Adventure Tours team. Their approach was not just professional but also incredibly humble and flexible, ensuring we had an unforgettable experience. Our group of five Thai friends explored Skardu, Hunza, Passu, and Gilgit at the peak of blossom season. Guided by the company’s CEO, Shah, whose extensive expertise in hiking and expeditions was evident, we found ourselves on a well-planned yet refreshingly adaptable journey. We appreciated how our tour leader went above and beyond, recommending exclusive experiences—from an insightful cultural visit to a local Pakistani home to a glacier trek using a unique route. Unlike standard itineraries, this allowed us to truly get up close and touch the glacier, all while ensuring our safety with expert guidance. One of the highlights was our trek to Fairy Meadows. With hours of hiking ahead, our guide was highly attentive, carefully assessing the natural conditions and our group’s well-being, which made us feel completely safe every step of the way. I already can't wait to return to Pakistan in summer, autumn, and beyond! 😊 A little tip for fellow travelers: If you plan to visit areas that require trekking and hiking, I highly recommend familiarizing yourself with the terrain beforehand. You can always check with the Summit Experts Adventure Tours team about the travel conditions—just to be prepared, not to opt out! The beauty of northern Pakistan is absolutely worth the effort.

He was also just the nicest guy and we all had many laughs together along our journey. I cannot thank him enough. He was the best driver in Pakistan. I would massively recommend using Summit Experts for any type of trip. For summits, hikes or just exploring the areas. They cover it all and the nicest kindest people. Thank you to everyone who made this trip extremely special and memorable for us. We can’t wait to show how beautiful Pakistan is to all our friends and family. Dil Pakistan. Until we meet again.

A Journey to Remember
I just returned from an incredible month-long adventure in northern Pakistan with Summit Experts Adventure Tours. We trekked through some of the most breathtaking regions: Skardu, Hunza, Shimshal Village, and made our way to Shimshal Pass, ending with the exhilarating summit of Manglik Sar (6050m). From the very first moment, I knew I was in the hands of true professionals. The entire trip was perfectly organized, from the logistics to safety measures. But what truly made this experience stand out was the team. Every single person was warm, supportive, and treated me like family. Over the course of the trek, they all became a second family to me, and I genuinely feel like I’ve made lifelong friends. The beauty of the Karakoram combined with the knowledge, passion, and dedication of the Summit Experts team made this adventure unforgettable. I felt supported, safe, and inspired every single day. I don’t add pictures, because you MUST visit and see all the beauty of Pakistan with your own eyes. Nothing can compare to standing there in person, taking in the vastness and the majesty of the Karakoram range. Thanks to the expertise of Summit Experts, I felt safe and supported every step of the way. The team’s passion for the mountains and commitment to making sure each trekker has the best possible experience is what really sets them apart. This wasn’t just a trek—it was an unforgettable journey, and I already can’t wait to return. I’m already thinking about next year and planning to do even more trekking in Pakistan. There’s so much more to explore, and I wouldn’t want to do it with anyone else but Summit Experts. If you’re considering an adventure in Pakistan, I cannot recommend this company enough. Beyond the ordinary
It took me some time to find the right words to capture the incredible memories we created during our trip to northern Pakistan this April—blossom season at its absolute best! The breathtaking views, the warmth of the people, and the richness of the culture left a lasting impression on me, all made even more special by the Summit Experts Adventure Tours team. Their approach was not just professional but also incredibly humble and flexible, ensuring we had an unforgettable experience. Our group of five Thai friends explored Skardu, Hunza, Passu, and Gilgit at the peak of blossom season. Guided by the company’s CEO, Shah, whose extensive expertise in hiking and expeditions was evident, we found ourselves on a well-planned yet refreshingly adaptable journey. We appreciated how our tour leader went above and beyond, recommending exclusive experiences—from an insightful cultural visit to a local Pakistani home to a glacier trek using a unique route. Unlike standard itineraries, this allowed us to truly get up close and touch the glacier, all while ensuring our safety with expert guidance. One of the highlights was our trek to Fairy Meadows. With hours of hiking ahead, our guide was highly attentive, carefully assessing the natural conditions and our group’s well-being, which made us feel completely safe every step of the way. I already can't wait to return to Pakistan in summer, autumn, and beyond! 😊 A little tip for fellow travelers: If you plan to visit areas that require trekking and hiking, I highly recommend familiarizing yourself with the terrain beforehand. You can always check with the Summit Experts Adventure Tours team about the travel conditions—just to be prepared, not to opt out! The beauty of northern Pakistan is absolutely worth the effort.

Overview

About Expedition

This adventure takes you deep into the heart of the Karakoram Range, offering a thrilling exploration of Rakaposhi, Diran Peak, and the serene Kacheli Lake. Over 11 days, you will trek through lush valleys, across glaciers, and to awe-inspiring high-altitude campsites. From the bustling city of Islamabad to the remote alpine meadows of Minapin and beyond, this journey combines cultural discovery with breathtaking natural beauty. Each day brings a new challenge and an opportunity to immerse yourself in the majesty of Pakistan’s northern landscapes.

Why This Tour?

✅ Iconic Peaks: Get up close to two of Pakistan’s most iconic mountains—Rakaposhi (7,788m) and Diran Peak (7,266m).

✅ Diverse Terrain: Experience everything from alpine meadows and lush forests to rugged glaciers and high-altitude lakes.

✅ Authentic Culture: Explore local villages like Minapin and Gilgit, engage with hospitable communities, and visit ancient cultural sites.

✅ Tailored Comfort: Enjoy a range of accommodation options—from premium hotels in major cities to immersive camping experiences in the wilderness.

✅ Unforgettable Memories: Capture breathtaking views, trek across glaciers, and witness the serenity of Kacheli Lake, a hidden gem at 4,000m.

Itinerary

Day 01: Islamabad

  • Arrival at the Islamabad International Airport
  • Pick up from the Islamabad Airport by our Guide and Driver
  • Drive to Hotel and Check In
  • Rest at the Hotel
  • Meet our team and briefing about the adventure a head
  • Prepare yourself for the adventure a head
  • Night Stay in Islamabad

 

Stay Options:

  • Premium: Islamabad Serena Hotel
  • Luxury: Roomy Signature Hotel
  • Standard: Grand Islamabad Hotel

Day 02: Islamabad to Chilas

  • Departure for Chilas (Distance: ~460 km, Drive Time: ~10-11 hours)
  • Drive on Hazara Motorway
  • Pass through Abbottabad (scenic hill station), Mansehra, and Besham
  • Visit Naran (seasonal via Babusar Pass, stunning alpine views) or continue via KKH past Dasu and Kohistan (rugged landscapes, Indus River)
  • Small stops on the way 
  • Arrival and check-in at hotel in Chilas
  • Night stay in Chilas

Stay Options:

  • Premium: Shangrila Hotel Chilas
  • Luxury: Shangrila Hotel Chilas
  • Standard: Indus Lodges Chilas

Day 03: Chilas to Minapin Village

  • Departure for Minapin Village (Distance: ~205 km, Drive Time: ~5-6 hours)
  • Drive on Karakoram Highway (KKH)
  • Pass through Gilgit (bustling town), Junction Point near Jaglot (where Karakoram, Himalayas, and Hindu Kush meet), and Rakaposhi Viewpoint (first glimpse of Rakaposhi)
  • Small stops on the way (e.g., Junction Point for photos)
  • Arrival and check-in at guesthouse in Minapin
  • Night stay in Minapin

Stay Options:

  • Premium: Roomy Ushu Thang
  • Luxury: Roomy Ushu Thang
  • Standard: Cherry Garden Minapin

Day 04: Trek from Minapin to Hapakun Campsite

  • Departure for Hapakun (Distance: ~5.8 km, Trek Time: 3-4 hours)
  • Trek begins at Minapin Village, cross Minapin River footbridge
  • Pass through juniper trees, apricot groves, and steep switchbacks
  • Arrival at Hapakun meadow (views of Hachindar and Maiun peaks)
  • Set up camp at Hapakun
  • Night stay in tents at Hapakun

Stay Options:

  • Camping

Day 05: Trek from Hapakun to Rakaposhi Base Camp (Tagaphari)

FAQs

01

How difficult is this trek?

+

This is a moderate to challenging trek. It involves steep ascents, rocky paths, and high-altitude trekking. A good fitness level is recommended.

02

What is the total duration of the trek?

+

The trek takes 10 to 12 days, including travel time from Islamabad to Minapin and back.

03

What is the maximum altitude we will reach?

+
  • Rakaposhi Base Camp: ~3,500 meters
  • Diran Peak Base Camp: ~3,900 meters
  • Kacheli Lake: ~3,650 meters
04

What is the best time for this trek?

+

The best seasons are Summer (June–August) and Autumn (September–October) when the weather is stable and the views are clear.

05

What kind of accommodation is provided?

+

Accommodation includes:

Hotels or guesthouses in Minapin Village

Camping at Rakaposhi Base Camp, Diran Peak Base Camp, and Kacheli Lake

06

What is the temperature like during the trek?

+

Summer: 10°C to 25°C during the day, dropping to 0°C at night

Autumn: 5°C to 20°C during the day, dropping to -5°C at night

07

Is prior trekking experience necessary?

+

Prior trekking experience is not mandatory but is highly recommended. A good fitness level is essential.

08

What should I pack for this trek?

+

A detailed packing list is provided, but key items include:

  • Trekking boots
  • Warm clothing & waterproof gear
  • Sleeping bag (-5°C to -10°C rating)
  • Trekking poles & sunglasses
  • Personal first-aid kit
09

Are porters and guides available?

+

Yes, we provide experienced guides and porters can be arranged if a client requires them but it will have additional cost depending on the weight.

10

Will there be mobile network coverage?

+

Mobile network coverage is limited after Minapin. Satellite communication may be available in emergencies.

11

What are the food options during the trek?

+

We provide freshly prepared meals at campsites. The menu includes local and standard trekking meals.

12

How do we manage altitude sickness?

+

We follow a proper acclimatization schedule, keep a steady pace, and encourage hydration. Our guides are trained to handle altitude-related issues.

13

Can I charge my phone or camera during the trek?

+

Charging facilities are available in Minapin but not at higher camps. In higher camps our priority is to keep the necessary devices charged first. if possible phones can be charged depending on the situation. We recommend bringing a power bank or solar charger.

14

Is travel insurance necessary?

+

Yes, travel insurance covering high-altitude trekking is highly recommended.

15

What is the booking process?

+

You can contact us for availability, make a deposit, and receive confirmation along with a detailed itinerary.

  • Road transport

Overview

About the Pilgrimage
The Sikh Pilgrimage Tour offers a profound spiritual and cultural journey through some of the most revered Sikh heritage sites in Pakistan. This 7-day expedition takes you from Lahore to Islamabad, allowing you to explore the sacred Gurdwaras associated with Guru Nanak Dev Ji and other Sikh Gurus. From the birthplace of Guru Nanak at Nankana Sahib to his final resting place at Kartarpur, every step of this pilgrimage is a tribute to Sikh history, faith, and devotion.

Why This Tour?

✅ Spiritual Journey: Walk in the footsteps of Guru Nanak Dev Ji and other Sikh Gurus, visiting 14 historically significant Gurdwaras.

✅ Cultural Exploration: Immerse yourself in the rich Sikh heritage, learning about centuries-old traditions and spiritual teachings.

✅ Seamless Experience: Enjoy a well-organized pilgrimage with expert guides, comfortable accommodations, and dedicated support throughout the journey.

✅ Iconic Sites: Visit world-renowned Gurdwaras, including Kartarpur Sahib, Gurdwara Janam Asthan, and Panja Sahib, each offering a unique spiritual and historical connection.

✅ Memorable Encounters: Participate in the sacred Langar (community kitchen), engage with local Sikh communities, and experience the warmth of hospitality along the way.

  • Drive back to Lahore – 24 km (45 min)

  • Breakfast at the hotel

  • Visit Gurdwara Janam Asthan (Birthplace of Guru Nanak Dev Ji)
  • Visit Gurdwara Patti Sahib, Bal Lila Sahib & Kiara Sahib
  • Drive to Gurdwara Sacha Sauda – 37 km (1 hr)
  • Visit Gurdwara Sacha Sauda (Site of Guru Nanak’s divine teachings)
  • Drive back to Lahore – 117 km (2.5 hrs)
  • Night stay in Lahore

  • Drive back to Lahore – 125 km (3 hrs)

  • Visit Gurdwara Rohri Sahib, Chakki Sahib & Bhai Lalo Sahib
  • Drive to Islamabad – 275 km (4.5 hrs)
  • Check-in at the hotel in Islamabad
  • Night stay in Islamabad

  • Premium: Islamabad Serena Hotel/Marriott Hotel, Islamabad
  • Luxury: Roomy Signature Hotel
  • Standard: Grand Islamabad Hotel

Day 06: Visit Gurdwara Panja Sahib & Return to Lahore

  • Breakfast at the hotel

  • Standard: Lahore Grand Hotel

Day 05: Visit Gurdwaras in Eminabad & Drive to Islamabad

  • Breakfast at the hotel
  • Drive to Eminabad – 55 km (1.5 hrs)
  • Visit Gurdwara Rohri Sahib, Chakki Sahib & Bhai Lalo Sahib
  • Drive to Islamabad – 275 km (4.5 hrs)
  • Check-in at the hotel in Islamabad
  • Night stay in Islamabad

Stay Options:

  • Premium: Islamabad Serena Hotel/Marriott Hotel, Islamabad
  • Luxury: Roomy Signature Hotel
  • Standard: Grand Islamabad Hotel

Day 06: Visit Gurdwara Panja Sahib & Return to Lahore

  • Breakfast at the hotel
  • Drive to Hassan Abdal – 50 km (1 hr)
  • Visit Gurdwara Panja Sahib (Sacred handprint of Guru Nanak on a rock)
  • Drive back to Lahore – 380 km (4.5 hrs)
  • Check-in at the hotel in Lahore
  • Night stay in Lahore

Stay Options:

  • Premium: Nishat Hotel Gulberg/PC Hotel, Lahore
  • Luxury: Luxus Grand Hotel, Lahore
  • Standard: Lahore Grand Hotel

Day 07: Departure – End of Pilgrimage

  • Breakfast at the hotel
  • Transfer to Allama Iqbal International Airport or Wagah Border
  • Departure for onward journey

Key Information

  • Key Gurdwaras Visited: 14 (including Kartarpur Sahib, Nankana Sahib, and Panja Sahib).
  • Highest Altitude: ~550m (Islamabad region).
  • Best Season: March, April, June, and November.

FAQs

01

What is the duration of the Sikh Pilgrimage Tour?

+

The tour lasts 7 days and 6 nights, covering major Sikh heritage sites across Lahore, Nankana Sahib, Kartarpur, Eminabad, and Islamabad.

02

Which Gurdwaras will we visit during the tour?

+

You will visit 14 key Gurdwaras, including:

  • Gurdwara Dera Sahib (Lahore)
  • Gurdwara Janam Asthan (Nankana Sahib – Birthplace of Guru Nanak Dev Ji)
  • Gurdwara Darbar Sahib (Kartarpur – Final resting place of Guru Nanak Dev Ji)
  • Gurdwara Panja Sahib (Hassan Abdal – Sacred handprint of Guru Nanak Dev Ji)

And many others significant to Sikh history and spirituality.

03

Is the tour suitable for all age groups?

+

Yes! The tour is designed for all age groups, with comfortable transportation and minimal walking at most sites.

04

What documents are required for the tour?

+

International travelers need:

  • Valid passport with a Pakistani visa
05

What should I wear during the pilgrimage?

+
  • Modest attire covering arms and legs (required for Gurdwara visits)
  • Head covering (scarf or bandana) is mandatory for both men and women at all Gurdwaras.
06

What is included in the tour package?

+

The package includes:

  • Accommodation (comfortable hotels)
  • All transportation (including airport/border transfers)
  • Guided visits to all Gurdwaras and heritage sites
  • Daily meals (including Langar at select Gurdwaras)
07

What is not included in the package?

+

The package excludes:

  • International airfare
  • Visa and personal expenses (e.g., shopping, tips)
  • Travel insurance (recommended)
08

Is there any physical activity involved?

+

The tour involves moderate walking at heritage sites, but no strenuous physical activity is required.

09

Can we participate in Langar (community kitchen)?

+

Yes! Visitors are encouraged to partake in Langar at Gurdwaras, experiencing the Sikh tradition of community service and hospitality.

10

What is the best time to take this pilgrimage?

+

The best months are March, April, June, and November, offering comfortable weather for travel and exploration.

11

How do I book the Sikh Pilgrimage Tour?

+

You can contact us directly to book your pilgrimage, and our team will assist you with all travel arrangements and documentation.

Overview

This 12-day air adventure takes you deep into the Karakoram and Gilgit-Baltistan region, where you’ll experience majestic snow-covered mountains, frozen lakes, and the vibrant cultures of Skardu and Hunza. Designed for those who prefer a shorter, scenic journey without long road travel, this tour is perfect for travelers seeking an unforgettable winter and spring exploration.

Why This Tour?

    • Scenic Flights & Quick Access – Enjoy breathtaking aerial views of Nanga Parbat and Karakoram Peaks as you fly into Skardu.
    • Cultural & Natural Wonders – Explore Baltit & Altit Forts, Attabad Lake, Shigar Valley, and Khunjerab Pass.
    • Luxury & Comfort – Stay in handpicked premium and luxury accommodations with seamless transportation.
    • Winter & Spring Beauty – Witness Skardu’s frozen lakes, snow-covered valleys, and Hunza’s spring bloom.

Itinerary

Day 1: Arrival in Islamabad – Capital Welcome

Upon arrival at Islamabad International Airport, our team will meet you and transfer you to your hotel. After check-in, take some time to relax before meeting the group for a welcome dinner. If time allows, explore Islamabad’s lively streets and local markets.

Stay Options:

  • Premium: Islamabad Serena Hotel
  • Luxury: Roomy Signature Hotel
  • Standard: Grand Islamabad Hotel

Day 2: Fly to Skardu – Enter the Karakoram

Catch a morning flight to Skardu (weather permitting) and enjoy stunning aerial views of Nanga Parbat and the Indus River. Upon landing, begin your Skardu Valley exploration with a visit to Upper and Lower Kachura Lakes. In the afternoon, head to Shigar Valley, where you will pass through the Cold Desert and Blind Lake before arriving at Shigar Fort for an insightful tour.

Stay Options:

  • Premium: Serena Shigar Fort
  • Luxury: Lokal Rooms Katpana
  • Standard: Eat and Read Hotel

Day 3: Discovering Khaplu – The Valley of Kings

Drive towards Khaplu Valley, stopping en route at Sailing Village, known for its stunning landscapes and Balti heritage. Visit the magnificent Khaplu Palace, a historical fortress that once served as a royal residence, and explore its surrounding areas before settling in for the night.

Stay Options:

  • Premium: Serena Khaplu Palace
  • Luxury: Destination Hotel
  • Standard: North Homes

Day 4: Manthoka Waterfall & Sadpara Lake Excursion

Today, set off to visit Manthoka Waterfall, a hidden gem tucked between towering cliffs. Spend time soaking in the beauty before heading to Sadpara Lake, an alpine lake known for its stunning reflections of snow-capped peaks.

Stay Options:

  • Premium: Byarsa Hotel
  • Luxury: Lokal Rooms Katpana
  • Standard: Eat and Read Hotel

Day 5: Journey to Hunza Valley – A Land of Legends

Depart early for Hunza Valley, traveling through Astak Nala, Alam Bridge, and the Karakoram Highway. Stop at Junction Point, where the three greatest mountain ranges—Himalayas, Hindu Kush, and Karakoram—converge. Continue your journey to Karimabad, the heart of Hunza, where you’ll explore the historic Baltit Fort, Altit Fort, and bustling Karimabad Bazaar.

Stay Options:

  • Premium: Hunza Serena Hotel
  • Luxury: Eagles Nest Hotel

Standard: Ayash Resort

Day 6: Gojal Valley – Attabad Lake & Gulmit Village

Head towards Gojal Valley, stopping at Attabad Lake, famous for its turquoise waters and dramatic mountain backdrop. Continue to Gulmit Village, where you can explore its heritage sites or embark on a scenic hike up the Ondra Poyga Trail.

Stay Options:

  • Premium: Luxus Resort Hunza
  • Luxury: Famree Resort

Standard: Silk Route Lodge

Day 7: Khunjerab Pass – The Gateway to China

Embark on an exciting journey through Hussaini Suspension Bridge, Passu Village, and Khunjerab National Park, home to rare wildlife such as snow leopards and ibex. Arrive at Khunjerab Pass (4,733m), the highest paved international border in the world.

Stay Options:

  • Premium: Luxus Resort Hunza
  • Luxury: Famree Resort

Standard: Silk Route Lodge

Day 8: Nagar Valley & Hoper Glacier

Today, explore Nagar Valley, a region known for its untouched beauty and stunning glaciers. Visit the Hoper Glacier Viewpoint, a vantage point offering breathtaking sights of the icy expanse of Hoper Glacier and Rakaposhi Peak.

Stay Options:

  • Premium: Hunza Serena Inn
  • Luxury: Eagles Nest Hotel
  • Standard: Ayash Resort

Day 9: Naltar Valley – The Hidden Paradise

Set off for Naltar Valley, famous for its colorful lakes, snow-covered pine forests, and dramatic mountain scenery. Visit the mesmerizing Satrangi Lake, known for its multi-hued reflections. Later, drive to Gilgit City, where you’ll visit the Kargah Buddha and NLI Market.

Stay Options:

  • Premium: Gilgit Serena Hotel
  • Luxury: Riverdale Hotel
  • Standard: Mandarin Inn

Day 10: Return Flight to Islamabad – Capital Leisure

Fly from Skardu back to Islamabad and check in to your hotel. Enjoy a relaxing evening, followed by a farewell dinner with the team.

Stay Options:

  • Premium: Islamabad Serena Hotel
  • Luxury: Roomy Signature Hotel
  • Standard: Grand Islamabad Hotel

Day 11: Islamabad Sightseeing & Cultural Tour

Spend your last full day exploring Islamabad’s cultural landmarks, including Faisal Mosque, Pakistan Monument, and the scenic Daman-e-Koh viewpoint. Enjoy free time to shop for souvenirs or relax at your hotel.

Stay Options:

  • Premium: Islamabad Serena Hotel
  • Luxury: Roomy Signature Hotel
  • Standard: Grand Islamabad Hotel

Day 12: Departure – Farewell Pakistan

After breakfast, you’ll be transferred to Islamabad International Airport for your departure flight, concluding an unforgettable adventure through Skardu & Hunza.

Packing List

Spring Packing Checklist for Northern Pakistan - Summit Experts

Spring (late-March to May) is one of the best seasons to explore Northern Pakistan, with mild weather, blooming flowers, and lush green landscapes. To make sure you have a comfortable and enjoyable journey, we’ve prepared a comprehensive packing list for your adventure.

Essential Packing Categories:

  1. Luggage & Bags
    • Main Luggage (70-80L): A sturdy, spacious bag for all your essentials. Ensure it has waterproof covers for unexpected weather.
    • Daypack (30-40L): Ideal for carrying daily items like snacks, water, and your camera during excursions.
    • Padlocks: Secure your belongings during travel.
  2. Clothing
    • Upper Body:
      • Lightweight Jacket: Perfect for chilly mornings and evenings. Consider a windbreaker or fleece.
      • Long-Sleeve Shirts & T-Shirts: Comfortable, breathable fabrics are ideal for layering.
      • Rain Jacket: Waterproof and wind-resistant for unexpected spring showers.
    • Lower Body:
      • Trekking Trousers: Lightweight and quick-drying trousers for hikes and outdoor activities.
      • Comfortable Pants/Jeans: Suitable for both city tours and countryside visits.
    • General Tips:
      • Layer Up: The weather can vary, so layers will help you adjust to temperature changes.
      • Respect Local Culture: Modest clothing is recommended, especially in towns and cultural sites.
  3. Footwear
    • Hiking Boots: Well-worn, waterproof boots with good ankle support for trekking.
    • Comfortable Walking Shoes: For city exploration and casual outings.
    • Warm Socks: Preferably made of moisture-wicking material.
  4. Accessories
    • Sunblock (SPF 50+): Protects against strong UV rays.
    • Hat/Cap: For sun protection during hikes and outdoor tours.
    • Sunglasses: Good UV protection for your eyes.
    • Light Scarf/Bandana: Useful for dust protection and sun cover.
  5. Toiletries & Personal Care
    • Compact Toiletry Kit: Include essentials like toothpaste, deodorant, and moisturizer.
    • Travel Towel: Quick-drying and lightweight.
    • Wet Wipes & Hand Sanitizer: For maintaining hygiene during day trips.
  6. Hydration & Snacks
    • Reusable Water Bottle (Insulated Preferred): Stay hydrated, especially during hikes.
    • Energy Bars & Snacks: Lightweight snacks for quick energy boosts.
  7. Tech & Gadgets
    • Camera & Accessories: Capture stunning landscapes and cultural moments. Bring extra memory cards.
    • Power Bank: Essential for keeping devices charged on the go.
    • Travel Adapter: Ensure compatibility with local sockets.
  8. Important Documents
    • Passport: Must have at least six months of validity remaining.
    • Visa & Travel Insurance: Check visa requirements and carry printouts of your insurance details.
    • Emergency Contact Information: A printed list of important contacts.

Tips for Spring Travel

  • Prepare for Variable Weather: Spring can bring unexpected showers, so a waterproof jacket and protective covers for your belongings are recommended.
  • Comfortable Layers: Temperatures fluctuate, so plan for both warm afternoons and cool evenings.
  • Be Ready for Long Walks: Comfortable shoes and a light backpack will make your excursions more enjoyable.

Why Travel with Summit Experts?

Our experienced team ensures that your journey is not just comfortable, but also safe and unforgettable. We provide personalized packing recommendations based on your specific tour itinerary, and our guides are always ready to help you with any last-minute needs.
